lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated intensity that coincide with the horizontal alignment of the circular blobs, creating a grid-like intersection pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple linear features oriented horizontally with a distinct luminance gradient, characterized by high-intensity upper edges and shadowed lower edges, traversing the upper flank.
